prerequisites.detail: Credentials must belong to an active, invited user in the Help Scout account, or the API returns 401.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Take the callback URL from the Composio dashboard and check it is HTTPS and network reachable.

steps.title: Enter redirection URL in app

steps.title: Create Composio auth config

steps.title: Test a user connection

traps.title: Access tokens expire after 2 days

traps.title: Free plan lacks API access

evidence.answer: The app must comply with the branding requirements of the associated APIs or product.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Ensure your app complies with the Google APIs Terms of Service
evidence.answer: The app must comply with the Google APIs Terms of Service and the Google API Services User Data Policy.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Data that you receive from a Google API must only be used in compliance with
evidence.answer: Data received from a Google API must only be used in compliance with that API's policies and as represented to users and in the privacy policy.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: Help Scout uses OAuth 2.0 but publishes no discrete scopes — access is governed by the grant itself (e.g. client-credentials or role-based authorization) rather than per-scope consent.
evidence.answer: A third-party catalog (not Help Scout's own docs) says Help Scout publishes no discrete OAuth scopes, so there is no per-scope consent tier that would trigger extra review; access is set by the grant and the user's role.

evidence.question: G5
evidence.quote: Access tokens expire after 2 days
evidence.answer: Help Scout's docs state access tokens expire after 2 days; the page does not say this is shorter in any unreviewed or testing mode, and no test-user or install caps were found.
